features.title: Your playlists, together
features.description: Paste your provider’s details to fill the form, or connect with Xtream Codes, an M3U link or a local playlist file. Keep multiple profiles on your device. Pull to refresh Home or a library without leaving the screen.

features.title: A full TV guide
features.description: Load XMLTV schedules, fix unmatched channels, shift a guide that runs early or late, and use catch-up when your provider supports it.

features.title: Movies and series
features.description: Browse your provider’s library, choose seasons and continue with the next episode.

features.title: Your favorites first
features.description: Keep a favorite live channel on Home, pin Live TV categories, build lists and resume recent viewing.

features.title: Playback, in focus
features.description: Centered transport controls and a bottom timeline keep the picture clear. Audio, subtitles and supported player options stay close.

features.title: Take your settings with you
features.description: Export and import an encrypted backup of profiles and preferences. Use family controls for protected categories.

changes: The old native splash logo is removed. GlowTV’s launch film starts after the system handoff, while fonts load alongside it.
Previous and Next channel controls are visible during normal playback on both native and VLC players.
VLC uses a quieter header, centered transport and bottom audio, player and fullscreen actions.
Prepared search data is reused between queries, with fewer catalogue rebuilds for recent channels.
Existing playlists, favorites, signing, backups and playback engines are retained.
